Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Hema - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Riya - 8 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Pihu - 10 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Rishabh stands in the kitchen. Hema and Riya stand near him.]

Rishabh: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh makes tea for everyone.]

Rishabh: "This is amazing!"

[Rishabh chops onions for the curry.]

Rishabh (excited): "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh washes the dishes after dinner.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Rishabh feeds the dog.]

Rishabh: "Mom, look at this."

[Rishabh milks the cow.]

Rishabh: "Slowly, take it easy."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Rishabh (happily): "Okay, Mom."

[Rishabh pats his horse.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Hema and Riya stand near him.]

Riya: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Riya: "And then?"

[Rishabh sips hot tea from a cup.]

Riya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rishabh gulps down a glass of milk.]

Hema: "I'm ready!"

[Rishabh serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Rishabh (surprised): "What a day to remember!"
